admin.invite.email.subject: Your RideWELL admin account
admin.invite.email.text:
Hello {firstName},

A RideWELL {roleLabel} account has been created for you. Open this link within 72 hours to set your password and two-factor authentication:

{link}

If you were not expecting this, ignore this email.
